prompt: OrderLine.java and SalesOrder.java are provided and complete. Use the Stream API in SalesAnalytics.java for regional revenue, revenue per category in a TreeMap, a ranked customer list, the largest order as an Optional, and a count of distinct products.
explanation: Each question is one pipeline. flatMap turns a stream of orders into a stream of their lines, which is what makes per-category totals possible; groupingBy with a downstream summingDouble collects those totals, and passing TreeMap::new keeps the keys sorted. Ranking customers needs a two-part comparator -- value descending, then key ascending -- so that equal spends still come out in a predictable order, and max returns an Optional precisely because an empty list has no answer.
hints: revenueIn: filter on the region, then mapToDouble(SalesOrder::total).sum(), and round the result once at the end.
For the per-category totals, flatMap(order -> order.getLines().stream()) first, then groupingBy(OrderLine::getCategory, TreeMap::new, Collectors.summingDouble(OrderLine::lineTotal)).
Sort the entry set with Map.Entry.comparingByValue(Comparator.reverseOrder()).thenComparing(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()), then limit(n) and map to the key.
